newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to extend Paris Roissy airport.
newsitem.headline: France to extend Paris Roissy airport.

text.p: The French government said in a statement on Friday it had given the go-ahead for the 1.5 billion franc extension of the Roissy-Charles de Gaulle airport north of Paris.
The plan calls for two new short runways, parallel to the existing ones, to be used for landing only.
The statement by Prime Minister Alain Juppe and other ministers said that this replaced a previous plan for a fifth full service runway which would be used both for landing and take-offs.
An independent body will be created to monitor noise which the government said would be equal to current levels "or if possible less".
A spokeswoman for the transport ministry said that the first of the two runways would be opened at the end of 1998 and the second in 2000.
